mapper.select: SELECT b.status AS basecamp_status, b.completed_at AS completed_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM basecamp_member bm WHERE bm.basecamp_id = b.id AND bm.member_id = #{reviewerId} AND bm.status = 'ACTIVE') AS reviewer_active, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM basecamp_member bm WHERE bm.basecamp_id = b.id AND bm.member_id = #{revieweeId} AND bm.status = 'ACTIVE') AS reviewee_active, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review cr WHERE cr.basecamp_id = b.id AND cr.reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} AND cr.reviewee_id = #{revieweeId}) AS already_written FROM basecamp b WHERE b.id = #{basecampId}

SELECT b.id AS basecamp_id, b.title AS basecamp_title, b.completed_at AS completed_at, t.member_id AS target_id, m.nickname AS target_nickname FROM basecamp b JOIN basecamp_member me ON me.basecamp_id = b.id AND me.member_id = #{memberId} AND me.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN basecamp_member t ON t.basecamp_id = b.id AND t.member_id <> #{memberId} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN member m ON m.id = t.member_id WHERE b.status = 'COMPLETED' AND b.completed_at >= #{writableSince} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review cr WHERE cr.basecamp_id = b.id AND cr.reviewer_id = #{memberId} AND cr.reviewee_id = t.member_id) ORDER BY b.completed_at ASC, b.id ASC, t.member_id ASC

SELECT r.id AS review_id, r.basecamp_id AS basecamp_id, b.title AS basecamp_title, b.completed_at AS completed_at, r.reviewer_id AS reviewer_id, m.nickname AS reviewer_nickname, r.rejoin_wanted AS rejoin_wanted, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.tag) FROM companion_review_tag t WHERE t.review_id = r.id) AS tags, r.comment AS comment, r.created_at AS created_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review rv WHERE rv.basecamp_id = r.basecamp_id AND rv.reviewer_id = r.reviewee_id AND rv.reviewee_id = r.reviewer_id) AS reverse_written FROM companion_review r JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = r.basecamp_id JOIN member m ON m.id = r.reviewer_id WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{memberId} AND r.hidden_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.tag) FROM companion_review_tag t WHERE t.review_id = r.id) AS tags, r.comment AS comment, r.created_at AS created_at FROM companion_review r JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = r.basecamp_id WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{memberId} AND r.hidden_at IS NULL AND (b.completed_at < #{revealCutoff} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review rv WHERE rv.basecamp_id = r.basecamp_id AND rv.reviewer_id = r.reviewee_id AND rv.reviewee_id = r.reviewer_id)) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
